messages:
maddie: Quick check — webinar next Wed 10am PT. Need final X + LinkedIn copy, GIFs, and gated LP link by EOD tomorrow. Who can take assets?
ryan: I can draft 3 X variants + 2 LinkedIn posts. Will need hero GIF from design. ETA noon tomorrow?
ana: small q — do we want separate copy for enterprise vs dev audiences or one neutral thread?
ana: (oh nvm, I can handle segmentation after copy lands)
joel: Design here — I'll add 2 GIF options to the webinar Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/webinar-assets. Aim for 5pm PT today.
ryan: @joel awesome. @maddie can you confirm the benchmark line we want in the openers? I can A/B headline.
maddie: yes — use the narrative but avoid unverified %s. Suggest: 'See 2-3x inference latency improvements and measurable cost reductions in production.'
ryan: Got it, will phrase as: "See 2–3x latency and ~30% lower inference cost on real workloads." I'll tag legal.
nana: I'll own seedlist + inbound routing. For Zapier -> SFDC flow, please confirm webhook path & token. I'll map form fields to SFDC lead fields.
maddie: @devops can you stand up the webhook? Need the path + ensure secret stored in Secrets manager.
social-bot: Reminder: Suggested live posting cadence for webinar day — pre (9:50am PT), start (10:05am PT), mid (10:35am PT), follow (11:00am PT).
joel: Uploaded GIFs to #design-assets: https://redwood-assets/designs/webinar_gifs. Two flavors: animated chart and product loop. Exporting 1200x675 + 800x800 variants now.
ryan: Great — can you include alt text and a 1MB-compressed version for X? GIF 2.4MB might not upload cleanly.
joel: Will do. Adding 1MB variant named webinar_gif_x_1mb.gif. Alt text: "Product demo loop showing reduced latency".
maddie: Checklist for EOD tomorrow: 1) copy in scheduler doc, 2) assets uploaded to design-assets, 3) LP live with UTM params, 4) Zapier webhook configured, 5) SDR routing rules published. Anything else?
nana: Add post-webinar follow-up sequence: Recording + TL;DR, benchmark summary, clear CTA + trial link. I'll draft the 3-email cadence.
ryan: Also note: need legal approval on benchmark wording. @maria-legal please review — I dropped eval notes & dataset summary in Drive.
maria-legal: Thx @ryan. Share the eval results and the prompt used for benchmarking. We aim for a 48h review turnaround. If claims are traceable, we'll approve.
ryan: Shared: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz — file "webinar_benchmarks_2026.xlsx" + eval_prompt.txt (in the same folder).
maddie: @ryan can you add the UTM examples to the copy doc? e.g.  ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr26
ryan: Done — copy doc now includes UTM snippets and sample posting cadence.
nana: For routing: rule draft — if company_size > 100 -> Enterprise SDR queue; otherwise -> inbound rotation. Also tag MQLs who watch >50% and visited pricing page. I'll push rules to the SDR handbook.
joel: GIFs ready: uploaded webinar_gif_x_1mb.gif and webinar_gif_1200x675.gif. Shared link in scheduler doc.
maddie: Perfect. Final asks: ryan (copy + legal loop), joel (compressed assets), ana (seedlist + SDR rules + Zapier mapping), devops (webhook + secrets). React with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done so I can close out.
ryan: ✅ (will ping legal separately)
joel: ✅ exported + alt text added
maria-legal: I'll start review now, aim to clear by EOD tomorrow if all docs are complete.
social-bot: Scheduler draft saved: https://scheduler.redwood/webinars/18765 — please review times & variations.
maddie: Thanks team — I'll run the scheduler tomorrow AM and confirm final post times. If anything blocks, drop here. :thumbsup:
